processing: Twelve cues and one loop for the basic smelter at work (doc 44). Three rocks thrown onto a pile of rocks for a lump of ore or coal landing in the stone pot. Three logs thrown onto other logs as foley for a log pushed into the fire hole (not a stone hole). Three breaths through a tube for the Blacksmith blowing on the coals through its hollow stick: one through the plastic pipe its uploader blows a charcoal fire with, two through a cardboard tube; no fire burns in any of them, and each is the first 1.2 s or a 1.2 s stretch of a longer breath, faded out. Three drops of an aluminium ingot on a concrete floor as foley for the cast copper bar set down (not copper, not stone), low-passed at 8 kHz because aluminium rings brighter than copper. Each variant is a separate recorded event. The cues are cropped to start on the event, DC removed, gently high- and low-pass filtered (zero phase), edge-faded and set to the level below subject to its peak ceiling. The loop is 31 s of a wood-fired pottery kiln's fire, as foley for the fire in the boulder while copper melts (not a smelting fire): DC removed, gently high- and low-pass filtered, its loudest pops rounded off with tanh at four times the stretch's RMS as the campfire's are, its last two seconds crossfaded into its first with equal power, and set to the campfire's level. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, added reverberation or denoising. Two cues have their own target so that their kind's variants are heard alike: smelt_log_02 a little higher, smelt_bar_02 a little lower. Runtime cosmetic pitch variation remains for the cues.
